comparison.objective: Hold a spring-loaded release collet while pulling a pipe from a push-fit fitting; candidate unlocks and adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR maintains collet depression with one hand while extracting and placing a pipe with the other. Candidate sequences hex-bit engagement, screw loosening, bit withdrawal, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, retightening, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the pipe extracted and laid flat, with staged credit for collet depression and pull distance. Candidate requires two safe stopping cycles and ≤2° setting drift.
comparison.reason: Although both involve releasing a lock before manipulation, simultaneous collet-hold-and-pull tests a different mechanism and outcome from captive-screw adjustment and response-based commissioning.
